defmodule Logistics.Freight.Carrier do
  @moduledoc """
  A freight carrier.

  `code` is a case-insensitive string (`citext`), and `retired_at` tracks when the
  carrier stopped operating. A carrier is considered \"live\" only as long as
  `retired_at` is `NULL`; any read of carriers is scoped to live carriers, and a
  carrier whose `code` collides with an already retired carrier is accepted.
  """

  use Ash.Resource,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    extensions: []

  resource do
    default_primary_key :id
    default_read_action :read
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id

    attribute :code, :ci_string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :name, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :retired_at, :utc_datetime_usec
  end

  relationships do
    has_many :shipments, Logistics.Freight.Shipment,
      destination_field: :carrier_id,
      read_action: :read
  end

  postgres do
    table "carriers"
    repo Logistics.Repo

    unique_index [:code], name: "carriers_unique_code_index", where: "retired_at IS NULL"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:create, :update, :destroy]

    read :read do
      primary? true
      filter expr(is_nil(retired_at))
    end
  end
end
